title: Chapter 1114
text:
One hundred Awakening Points for a Unique Talent. This cost was not low, but at least it pointed out a path. Han Xiao doubted that with his luck, he would not be able to find anything even if he tried for a hundred years.

He estimated that the method of custom synthesis would be the same as when he created his own Species Talent when he advanced to Beyond Grade A. He would provide his preference and then proceed with random selection. The Unique Talent obtained after synthesis would only be in its embryonic form, and he would have to spend more Awakening Points to activate it.

With all his Class Knowledges maxed out, Potential Points would become Awakening Points. It should be the same for Manison and the other Mechanics.

The difference was that unlike him, Manison and the others could not freely allocate their Awakening Points.

In that case, the other Mechanics would not be able to decide what to do with their Awakening Points. It would most likely be a random effect. He guessed that it would be similar to a flash of inspiration during training or research.

"Although the cost is a little high, at least it's a stable way to obtain Unique Talents."

Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. He had been eyeing this thing for so many years, and he finally saw hope.

However, the cost-performance ratio was still debatable. One hundred Awakening Points was equivalent to ten thousand Free Attribute Points. His current highest Intelligence attribute was less than thirty thousand. If he exchanged them all for Free Attribute Points, the increase would be huge. Only by obtaining a Molding Talent would it not be a loss.

However, since it was called a Unique Talent, its effect should not be too bad. You get what you pay for.

Han Technician still remembered Sorokin's Unique Talent [Swindler Sorokin]. Just his Intelligence and Mystery attributes alone increased by twenty percent, as well as an additional seventy-five percent increase in Esper Ability strength and skill level by four.

Old Mai's [Virtual Technology Innovation Manison] gave him a 1.75 x Virtual Technology enhancement effect. Furthermore, it was the foundation of the 'Indestructible Mecha Empire' technology.

Both of them were Molding Talents.

"True knowledge comes from practice. Although the cost is a little high, I still have to get one to see the effect."

Han Xiao had just leveled up more than a hundred blueprints, and he had spent all his Potential Points. He did not have enough Experience to gather another hundred Awakening Points.

"Sigh, Awakening Points … Such an apt name. It's another huge EXP drain. I'll think about it after I Promote …"

Han Xiao shook his head. The main reason he had maxed out all his classes was to obtain one more God's Trait Transformation Point when he Promoted in the future.

Now that he had achieved it, the Level 340 Promotion became his top priority once more.

Other than these changes, the interface also notified him that he had obtained a new [The First Sanctum] Skill Fragment.

Han Technician had already figured out the pattern. When he crossed the threshold of a certain Mechanic class, he would receive a fragment of The First Sanctum.

The first came from activating God's Trait Transformation, the second came from creating his first Universal Treasure, the third came from the fifth stage of God's Trait Transformation, and the fourth came from now.

"I'd like to see how many fragments are needed to make it whole. If you're so capable, why don't you give me 100 fragments?"

Han Xiao cursed in his heart.

Overall, he was very satisfied with the effect of maxing out all his Class Knowledges. It had pointed out a new path for him to grow. The biggest difference between him and the other Beyond Grade As was in this aspect. His growth path was clearly visible.

At the same time, with [Machinery Great Sage], the chances of challenging Manison would be higher.

"Last time, I suffered a loss in the virtual world. This time, I'm going to have a real fight with him."

Han Xiao was eager to give it a try, his fighting spirit soaring.

This kind of mentality could be explained simply.

The wind has stopped, the rain has stopped, and I feel like I can do it again!

Thud, thud, thud.

Just as Han Xiao was sorting out the changes in his body, someone knocked on the door, and Harrison walked in.

Over the past few months, Han Xiao had adhered to the principle of not wasting labor and had not let Harrison stay idle. Even if this guy was currently a criminal, Han Xiao did not mind letting him be his temporary secretary.

Other than giving Harrison something to do, he also arranged for him to stay by his side so that it would be convenient for him to freeload the Luck Glow all the time.

However, looking at the results, not only did he not freeload the Luck Glow, he even neutralized it quite a bit. It was a classic lose-lose situation.

Of course, Han Technician would not admit it. He firmly believed that this was because the quality of Harrison's Luck Glow was not good enough.

Fu Ding's Luck Glow was still the strongest. It was fine no matter how much he dragged him down.

Seeing him enter, Han Xiao closed the interface and asked casually, "What's up?"

"Do you have anything to report?"

"Your Excellency Black Star, the dynasty fleet wants me to tell you that they will temporarily leave your team and return to normal to carry out other missions."

"What happened?" Han Xiao was curious.

"The captain told me that this is a mission sent by the dynasty's upper echelons. They said that there's a problem with a Star System civilization, and it's not suitable for you to appear."

"What exactly is going on?"

"I took a report from them. Take a look."

Harrison took out a document and showed it to Han Xiao on the virtual screen.

Han Xiao skimmed through it and immediately understood.

Over the past few months, the various civilizations in the Ancient Star Desert had seen the big picture and had been cooperating with the three Universal Civilizations on the surface. They did not cause any trouble like the black market.

However, after the three Universal Civilizations announced that the three-piece antivirus set was completed, some civilizations seemed to feel that the disaster was under control and would not cause any serious consequences, so they caused a wave of trouble.

Three of the Star System civilizations involved were the Tiger Race, the White Hair Race, and the Ferians. They were not smuggling the virus but suspected of using the virus to attack their opponents.

The Tiger Race and the Ferians were both in the same Star System and bordered each other. They were sworn enemies and often had conflicts. The White Hair Race was in another neighboring Star System and only bordered the Tiger Race. The relationship between the two was relatively cold.

The situation was roughly like this. Not long ago, a mechanical rebellion broke out on an important administrative planet of the Tiger Race. This was a group of mechanical bodies infected with the Virtual Mutiny Virus. Because they had been disconnected from the internet for too long, the trigger mechanism took effect, and these mechanical bodies were reprogrammed by the virus to kill life forms.

The virus outbreak was limited to this group of mechanical bodies, and there were not many of them. The quantum network connection device of each of them had been removed long ago, so they could not go online and could not affect the other nodes of the planet. Therefore, the planet's guards easily annihilated this group of mechanical bodies, but there were still casualties.

After investigation, a rather realistic reason for the disaster spread on the internet, which was that this group of mechanical bodies was actually the material for the Tiger Race to study the Virtual Mutiny Virus. They accidentally went out of control, which led to this disaster.

After the news spread, the Tiger Race citizens were in an uproar. The public opinion went out of control, and they crazily attacked the regime.

The Tiger Race anxiously said that this was a rumor and that they did not study the virus at all. They claimed that these mechanical bodies were hidden on the planet by an unknown organization and calculated the day when the virus would break out. They purposely slandered their regime and damaged their credibility.

The angry citizens felt that this was an excuse, so the Tiger Race had no choice but to publicly ask the three Universal Civilizations for arbitration.

In the private report that Han Xiao saw, the Tiger Race explained to the three Universal Civilizations that this might be a scheme of the Ferians or the White Hair Race. Not only did they want to slander them, but they also wanted to frame a third party, causing a conflict between the two parties while they reaped the benefits.

The White Hair Race and the Ferians both had a motive, but the Tiger Race's words could not be trusted easily. Therefore, the three Universal Civilizations sent people to investigate. The current situation was complicated.

The Star System Civilizations were protected by the Peace Treaty, so the dynasty did not let Han Xiao interfere with the affairs of the civilizations. In this area, the three Universal Civilizations did not allow any other organizations to play dirty.

"The black market has been beaten up by me, but the civilizations are starting to jump …"

Han Xiao frowned. Although this matter was not under his control, it did not stop him from smelling danger.

He understood that the situation of the Ancient Star Desert being sealed made the various civilizations vigilant, especially the Super Star Cluster civilizations. The three big hooligans had long lost their credibility, so they would definitely prepare for the worst, keeping a trump card and holding the chips. However, this did not benefit the overall situation at all. It was a classic game of chess.

"I still have to deal with the virus as soon as possible. I can't delay any longer. I'll go use Explorer again."

Han Xiao got up and left the room, heading to the warehouse.

Walking into the room, he immediately saw the triangular device that had once stored the Virtual Mutiny Virus. It was lying there quietly.

The dynasty's research on it was to no avail. Seeing that Black Star had asked for it, they allowed Han Xiao to keep it by his side.

During this period, as long as the cooldown of (Bold Explorer) was over, Han Xiao would use the triangular device.

Unfortunately, after watching a bunch of scattered fragments, there were not many valuable clues. At most, he figured out part of the origin of the virus.

The mechanical civilization that he saw for the first time was the creator of the Virtual Mutiny Virus. This was indeed a weapon. The original intention of creating it was to deal with the unknown civilization that had used a Planetary Annihilation weapon to destroy a planet of the mechanical civilization.

The virus was programmed to kill living beings, and the mechanical civilization was naturally not within this range. It could be considered a high-level war weapon that did not harm its allies.

As for this mechanical civilization, it was actually an artificial intelligence civilization. Just like the AI civilization, all its citizens were artificial intelligence life forms, just more advanced.

The mechanical bodies that filled the streets were all shells that carried artificial intelligence life forms, which was equivalent to their vehicles in the real world. Their appearances were all self-made, so there were basically no duplicates.

Han Xiao found some unique words and symbols of this artificial intelligence civilization in the backtracking of (Bold Explorer) time and time again. However, after comparing them, he found that there were no relevant records in the databases of the three Universal Civilizations.

Either this artificial intelligence civilization was too old, and there was a gap in its history that even the three Universal Civilizations did not know about, or it was an advanced civilization in the unexplored universe.

Regardless of which it was, it basically confirmed that the source of the Virtual Mutiny Virus was the materialization phenomenon brought about by the Information Form disturbance, which was a 'mirage' that interfered with reality.

"I hope I can see some useful fragments this time.

Han Xiao glanced at Harrison beside him, took a deep breath, prayed for the blessing of the halo, and slowly pressed his hand on the cold surface of the triangular device.

Buzz!

The next moment, his vision suddenly changed, and he came to a bright laboratory.

He looked up, and his pupils suddenly constricted as a look of surprise flashed across his face.

He saw a triangular device placed in the middle of the room. It was not closed yet, revealing the safe inside. A group of mechanical bodies that looked like researchers stood beside it, operating the mechanical arms solemnly, putting a cluster of almost transparent light blue electric arcs into the device.

"Could this be the scene where the Virtual Mutiny Virus was just created? I finally got something this time! "

Han Xiao suppressed his joy and carefully observed this cluster of light blue electric arcs. He saw traces of electric arcs swimming in the air like a powerful electromagnetic field.

… This is the virus core?

Shouldn't it be virtual data? Why is it a cluster of electromagnetic energy?

Han Xiaoxin was confused.

At this time, an indifferent electronic voice sounded, and a mechanical researcher on the side pointed at the camera used to record the experiment process and spoke:

"Summary of the experimental object: Domino Virus, can infect quantum networks and rewrite the underlying logic of artificial intelligence. Currently programmed to kill all organic life forms.

"Raw materials: A thousand mutated artificial intelligence lives with their independent thoughts erased, leaving only the data shell and computing ability. "After 165 failed modifications, the Domino Virus was successfully created. The initial form of this virus has extremely high stealth, permeability, and infectivity.

"Virus Core: A set program without independent thoughts. As the control center, it controls the Domino Virus according to the input logic, monitors the infection situation, and chooses the right time to activate the virus. At the same time, it has the ability to self-evolve. When the opponent develops a targeted firewall, the virus core will automatically analyze the data and use its powerful computing ability to find loopholes. It will continuously update and strengthen the virus information package to carry out a new round of infection.

"Note: Starting from the second generation of the virus, all information packages are considered to be activated. Once infected, they will no longer be hidden and will immediately rewrite the target's logic.

"In addition, the virus core uses Virtual Soul, bioelectric simulation, magnetic field reconstruction, and so on. It has two forms of existence. It can turn into a Virtual Soul and swim freely in the quantum network. It can also leave the quantum network at any terminal and enter the material world, turning into an electromagnetic life form.

"Because the foundation of the virus core's existence is Virtual Soul, when it is in the electromagnetic field state, it can enter the quantum network at any time without touching the node. "Therefore, the virus core has extremely high escape and stealth abilities, as well as high mobility.

"If used properly, a single Domino Virus can destroy most of the armed forces of a galactic civilization and cause the civilization level of the target to regress many generations. Because it is too powerful, it needs to be used carefully. The Domino Virus is temporarily sealed and cannot be used without permission …"

Han Xiao's eyes slowly widened.

He felt like his young heart had received a huge blow.

If not for [Bold Explorer] seeing all this, no one in the universe would have known the true face of the Virtual Mutiny Virus!

Now, I'm the only one who knows this information. The others are still in the dark!

At this time, a bad thought appeared in his mind.

This is bad!

The plan of the three Universal Civilizations is not going to work!

This thing is more troublesome than I thought!
